latest.title: White House replaces cyber director Sean Cairncross amid widespread tech outages
latest.description: Sean Cairncross will be replaced by Pentagon chief information officer Kirsten Davies.

latest.title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
latest.description: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.

latest.title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
latest.description: The move would reduce Coinbase's reliance on a partnership Kalshi, which brought in $200 million in annualized revenue in the third quarter.

latest.title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
latest.description: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.

latest.title: CryptoUK Urges FCA Not to Treat DeFi Devs as Regulated by Default
latest.description: The UK crypto trade group broadly backed the regulator's proposed perimeter guidance, but warned that parts of it go further than the law.

latest.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
latest.description: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

latest.title: Kushner says Russia 'comfortable' with idea of NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine
latest.description: Kushner said President Donald Trump is open to such a guarantee, but its form and whether Russia and Ukraine would accept it remain unclear.

latest.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
latest.description: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

latest.title: Putin scores ‘massive win’ at first trilateral meeting, rebuilding standing as Ukraine war grinds on
latest.description: Putin was positioned as an equal beside the leaders of the U.S. and China, handing a win to the authoritarian leader bogged down in a multi-year war.

latest.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
latest.description: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.
